intro: Elder Bladeswift is an ancestral spirit honored during the Lunar Festival within the night elven capital of Darnassus. Located in the Cenarion Enclave, this ancient figure offers travelers wisdom drawn from the starry heavens above. Seeking his blessing connects adventurers directly to the revered traditions of the Cenarion Circle and the night elven people.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, friend. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?
